gallery.description: Members of the Cernăuți Court of Appeal (Curtea de Apel Cernăuți) at its foundation in mid-1919. From left to right, names and positions taken from the source:Top: Dimitrie C. Bagdad, Temistocle Bocancea, Dr. Corneliu Gheorghian  (Counselor), Dr. Nicolae Țurcan, Dr. Aureliu CăpăținăBottom: Dr. Vasile Boldur (President), Dimitrie Buzdugan (Minister of Justice), Dr. Dimitrie Tușinschi / Demeter von Tuschinski (Attorney General)

gallery.title: File:Curtea de Apel Cernauti 1934.jpg
gallery.description: Members of the Cernăuți Court of Appeal (Curtea de Apel Cernăuți), around mid 1934. Names and positions as per caption and previous pages in the source. In addition, dates of when they took up their posts at the Higher Regional Court (as of July 15, 1934). From left to right:Dr. Orest Chiseliță Orest (from 22 January 1930, councillor, delegated section chairman of the Local Revision Committee), Dimitrie I. Stefănescu (since January 21, 1930, councillor, delegated chairman of the Local Revision Committee), Dimitrie Androchovici (since March 1932, councillor), Ioachim Ciuntuleac (since October 1, 1928, councillor), Constantin Radovici (since January 1, 1926, councillor), Mihail Paraschivescu (since February 8, 1934, councillor), Dr. Orest I. Chisel (since January 21, 1930, councillor, delegated chairman of the Local Revision Committee), Dr. Orest I. Aurel Tarnavschi (from January 1, 1926, councillor, from May 20, 1933, councillor delegated to judicial inspectors), Gheorghe Iacubovici-Boldișor (from January 1, 1926, councillor), Gheorghe Vasiliu (from February 8, 1934, section prosecutor), Ilie Hudescu (from January 21, 1930, councillor, delegated section president to the Local Revision Committee).Lower row: Constantin Brumă (from January 1, 1926, councillor), Mihail A. Brăileanu (from 4 October 1924, 1 January 1926-28, October 1926 and 20 May 1933-21 November 1933, delegate of the Attorney General, 11 May 1931-20 May 1933, counselor of the delegates of the judicial inspectors), Claudiu Stefanelli (from 1 June 1920, counselor), Dimitrie Ariton (section president from 21 January 1930, counselor from 1 January 1926-21 January 1930), Dr. Dimitrie C. Tușinschi / Dr. Demeter Ritter von Tuschinski (First President from 1 January 1926, President of the Court from 4 October 1925-1 January 1926, Attorney General from 1 July 1919-4 October 1925), Theodor Alexandru (from 21 November 1933, Attorney General), Alexandru G. Antonescu (from October 4, 1924, section prosecutor), Dr. Eutimie Cercavschi-Ielita (from October 4, 1925, counselor, from January 1, 1926-July 1, 1930, counselor of the court inspectors), Ioan L. Ivanovici (from January 1, 1926, counselor).

gallery.title: File:Demeter Ritter von Tuschinski 1912 Colorized.jpg
gallery.artist: Unknown authorUnknown author, colorized and digitally expanded by Alexander Tuschinski
gallery.description: Dr. Demeter Ritter von Tuschinski: First Attorney of State in Czernowitz, Bukowina. Photo taken in 1912, shortly after receiving the Austrian Order of the Iron Crown 3rd class in July that year. After Bucovina became Romanian following the First World War, he was known as Dr. Dimitrie Tușinschi, which is the Romanian spelling of his name.
